title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode1 Music You Aspire To

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I apologize for making you all wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Mr. Shindo!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to meet with us today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be discussing what we need to do in preparation for our debut, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. After giving it a considerable amount of thought, I've put together a document for you all to look at...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is an overview of the marketing strategies for the bands who've debuted with us, as well as some artists who are seeing a lot of success right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These are the download figures for each first single... And here are the buyer demographics... Is it really okay for you to be showing us all this data?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, as long as this information doesn't leave here. It's certainly not for everyone to see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: U-Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now that you've all had a chance to look at these figures, today I'd like to discuss how your band is going to be marketed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How we're going to be marketed?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. First, I'd like to start by asking you all a question. What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aspirations for our music...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That includes your goals in terms of your music, as well as who you want listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In order for us to come up with a marketing strategy for your band, it's imperative we know exactly what your goals are.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
For example...
Please look at the very first page of the document in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this person... They sing a lot of Miku songs for their streams.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, that's because they want to enjoy music alongside their fans.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As such, they concentrate their efforts on streaming, taking song requests and having as close a relationship as possible with their fans.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On top of their earnings from subscriptions and merchandise sales, their high view counts have made things very lucrative.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Take a look at this page!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They placed first in the TV program School Band Fest when they were still in high school, and have been working as pros ever since.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Their goal is to prove to everyone that their band is worth a listen.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why they auditioned for that music talent program around the time of their debut. And when they won, it brought them popularity and name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As a result, greater numbers of people became interested in their shows and they now have an extremely supportive fan base.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're nothing like this other artist...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Exactly. And these are just a couple of examples. Your specific goals will greatly change how you'll be marketed and what you do as artists.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to hear what you wish to do and come up with a plan based on that.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
So, let me ask you again.
As pros, what would you like to do?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, what does Leo/need hope to achieve with its music?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about moving the hearts of those who listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I might've guessed.
After all, the performances I saw are why we're sitting here now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That being said, I'd like to know more. I want you all to dig deeper.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Deeper?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Think about what you've all felt as a band. What you've wished for. What you've hoped for...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There must be something more you want to achieve with your music besides moving the hearts of others...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If there is, I'd like for you to tell me about it. Now is your chance to tell me exactly what it is that you want your music to be about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: More than moving people's hearts...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But... What else is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes... But if it's hard for all four of you to come up with one answer, then we can also talk about what you feel individually.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Individually?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. Instead of Leo/need as a whole, we can talk about what you each wish to do. Please, don't hesitate to speak up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I want our music to be uplifting...
I want it to cheer people up.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Cheer people up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes... Back when Saku... After we played at the same venue as anemone, I started thinking about how to write a song about “understanding loneliness”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That time, I wrote a song while thinking about what I went through a long time ago... And I was so happy the crowd understood what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried writing a song that showed real empathy for someone who needed it. I wanted the listener to feel better after hearing it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to create more music like that.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I definitely got that when you played that song during your battle against anemone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, what about you three?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our music and my singing to help bring people together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Initially, I was happy with just trying to put on performances that could move people's hearts. But now, I want to do more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our music to be something that can help bring people together. Just like how Miku songs brought us together.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika both know exactly what they want our music to be about...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What else is there besides wanting to move people's hearts?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: How about you two, Ms. Mochizuki, Ms. Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand what Ichika and Saki are saying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wanting to be there for those who are in need. Wanting to bring people together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I understand what they want to do...
But I can't honestly say that I have any concrete goals like they do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I don't have anything specific either...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see... Then, it sounds like you both need some time to think.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... We're so sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
No, that's perfectly fine.
I wasn't expecting to hear your answers today.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If anything, you should think long and hard about this since it is going to have a profound effect on your band's future.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
So, please take your time.
And of course, I'm here to help any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...! Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
We'll talk about this again another time.
Until then, please think about what you wish to do.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also, there's nothing wrong with wanting to pursue the same goal as someone else, or one similar to your original goal. Try to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, once we have your individual goals in place, we'll figure out what Leo/need is going to try to achieve with its music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now, on to our next topic...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like to give you all an overview of what the process of debuting actually entails. Please take a look at this document regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! This part's about publicity photos... And this is about when our debut single's gonna release!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. Then, let's start discussing these points one at a time. Starting with...
